question: Should this Fireworks catalog expansion land only after preserving dynamic Kimi policy and resolving the no-off GPT-OSS clamp/proof gap, or should GPT-OSS be deferred from this PR?

options.title: Repair policy and proof before merge

options.title: Pause for provider proof
options.body: Hold the PR until redacted current-head live output proves the exact Fireworks model ids and effort ranges being cataloged.

recommendation.title: Repair policy and proof before merge
